prompts.ButtonFrame: Use case: ui-mockup. Production Unity sprite, transparent RGBA. Study the FOUR BOTTOM BUTTONS in the attached reference closely and reproduce their actual border language: clipped/chamfered rounded corners, TWO thin dark honey-gold contours, substantial luminous ivory enamel bevel between contours, delicate champagne inner rim, soft pale-gold shadow under the rim. Clean restrained fantasy mobile RPG craft, NOT baroque filigree curls. Create exactly ONE empty button FRAME, 2:1 width-to-height, centered, large, straight-on orthographic. All center pixels must be transparent; no ivory background filling. No icon, no text, no gem (gem is a separate sprite). Outer transparent margin 40px. Keep long edges straight and uniformly detailed for nine-slicing. The chamfered corners and layered ivory bevel must closely match the reference bottom buttons. No spikes, loops, curling ornament, no extra objects.
prompts.PanelFrame: Use case: ui-mockup. Production Unity transparent RGBA UI sprite. Use the attached reference's bottom ivory PLAYER STATUS CARD and remaining-distance plaque as strict visual reference. Make exactly ONE large empty wide rectangular PANEL FRAME, 4:1 aspect, soft rounded/chamfered corners, multi-layer thin warm gold contour, polished ivory enamel bevel, discreet small gold curled corner caps, gracefully recessed inner gold hairline, luminous hand-painted 2.5D fantasy mobile game finish. The whole interior is a transparent hole, NOT a paper panel. No wings, no portrait, no letters, no numbers, no icon. Outer transparent margin 40px. Long edges uniform and straight so the sprite can be 9-sliced to a tall result dialog as well. Match reference proportions and rich cream-and-gold material faithfully; avoid the thin dark antique picture-frame appearance.
prompts.Icons: Use case: ui-mockup. One production UI icon atlas PNG on genuine transparent background, exact 4x4 evenly sized grid, generous gaps, each icon fully contained in its own cell. Reference image is the UI visual style, especially its lower camera / double-play / skip / hamburger icons. Recreate that polished navy blue enamel with narrow golden bevel, warm dark outline and crisp hand-painted highlights. All front facing flat UI symbols, not text/font glyphs. NO labels or letters anywhere. 16 icons, row-major: row1 camera with blue lens; fast-forward two blue triangles with gold outline; skip one blue triangle plus gold vertical bar; menu three navy horizontal bars with gold bevel. row2 play single blue triangle gold bevel; pause two navy bars gold bevel; replay curved blue arrow with gold bevel; close navy X gold bevel. row3 trophy gold with blue inset; regal golden crown with cyan gem; single golden feather (no square background); gold laurel wreath surrounding EMPTY transparent middle. row4 upward arrow green enamel gold bevel; downward arrow muted coral enamel gold bevel; curved right-turn arrow gold like the reference phase badge; small downward-pointing gold marker triangle with ivory rim. Strict equal cells, clean alpha edges, large legible symbols. NO squares behind icons.
prompts.VictoryCrest: Use case: ui-mockup. One production Unity decorative UI crest on genuine transparent background, wide 3:1 aspect. Extend the supplied Ragnarok Fantasy UI language into a first-place victory crest: brilliant polished gold trophy in the center, two graceful ivory feather wings extending left and right, tiny cyan faceted gemstone on the trophy pedestal, royal-blue satin ribbon with gold edging gently draped underneath, its central face left entirely blank. Clean creamy highlights, navy and warm honey-gold outlines, rich but restrained mobile fantasy RPG hand-painted quality. No text, no numbers, no surrounding rectangular panel, no background, no particles or glow haze. Symmetric, front facing, fully isolated with 50px transparent margins.
